notes.title: Big Content Update!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45458184/8f496e513c48f0f947781a510918d9203b82a91f.png[/img]

There is more to discover in the depths of the ancient ocean! Put your skills to the test and battle a new secret boss! Search the caverns and uncover ancient ruins! Swim alone no longer--complete your adventure with a clam and sea urchin pet!

Added Features:
[list]
[*]New Secret Boss
[*]Clam Buddy
[*]New Platforming Challenge
[*]Sea Urchin Buddy
[*]Quality of life updates
[/list]

notes.title: Ancient Ocean: The Fall of Atlantis is now available!
notes.notes: [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45458184/f503e3a86db1cf3c458a7b3345361f76adf0ed64.png[/img]Submerge into the ancient ocean of the Cambrian period! Encounter mysterious creatures of times past in this short-and-sweet platforming adventure. Treat yourself to colorful SNES-inspired graphics and an extensive world to explore. Who knows what awaits you? OUT NOW!
